name: The Westin Beach Resort & Spa at Frenchman's Reef
positioning: The Westin St. Thomas Beach Resort & Spa: a Caribbean beach resort on Morningstar Beach near Charlotte Amalie, with an infinity-edge pool, ocean-view suites, a signature spa and its own catamaran
best_for: Families wanting a beach resort with a kids club and a family pool
Travelers who want sailing, snorkeling and kayaking from the resort
Couples wanting ocean-view balconies and a full-service spa

facts.text: The resort is at 5 Estate Bakkeroe, St. Thomas.
The resort has beach access, cabanas, and the Edge Pool, Family Pool and Serenity Pool.
Many rooms and suites offer ocean views with windows or balconies.
The spa includes couples' treatment rooms.
Dockside Watersports offers sunset sails, snorkeling adventures and night kayak trips.
Luna Mar serves coastal Mediterranean cuisine with Caribbean views and sunsets over Charlotte Amalie.
The Westin Family Kids Club offers daily activities for children.
A private marina for boat docking is steps from the resort.
The WestinWORKOUT fitness center is complimentary and has Peloton equipment.

highlights.text: The resort sits on Morningstar Beach.
The resort has an infinity-edge pool.
Bi-level suites have separate living and sleeping areas and private ocean-view balconies.
Guests can sail on the resort's Flying Frenchman catamaran, a sailboat or a private charter.
Heavenly Spa is the resort's signature spa with a full salon.

considerations.text: Rooms do not have a fridge.
Poolside cabanas are available for rent rather than included.
WhataHotel notes the island location requires flight connections for most travelers.
